limits.en: A free account is available giving access to a scorecard for one's own domain, questionnaire responses and basic dashboards.

cautions.en: No public price list; paid tiers (reported informally as Core, Premium, Elite) require contacting sales, and cost scales with the number of vendors/domains monitored plus optional add-on modules.

capabilities.en: Continuous third-party risk monitoring producing A-F security ratings for vendors and one's own organization.
Automatic discovery of hidden third- and fourth-party vendors across the extended supply chain.
AI-accelerated security questionnaire automation and predictive attack-path analytics (TITAN suite).

limitations.en: No self-serve pricing; a sales engagement is required to get a quote for any paid tier.
Oriented toward enterprise vendor-risk programs, not toward assessing one's own product for a small team.

reason.en: Alternative source of third-party risk/business data used in vendor due diligence.
Established provider of business and vendor risk data competing for the same due-diligence use case.

unknowns: No public pricing figures could be verified for any paid tier; third-party estimates exist but are not confirmed by SecurityScorecard's own site and were excluded.
